# Mythic Counseling of Florida

> Holistic, Humanistic Wellness, Tailored to Fit Your Needs. A Person-Centered, Non-Pathologizing Alternative to Mental Health, serving clients in Florida.

My approach to counseling brings together evidence-based therapeutic practices with a humanistic and existential understanding of personal growth and well-being. I believe that people are more than the diagnoses they carry or the experiences they have endured.

- Contact email: {{ site.email }}
- Online booking: {{ '/appointments/' | absolute_url }}
- Service area: {{ site.region }}

## Services

- [Free Initial 30 Minute Consultation]({{ '/services/free-consultation/' | absolute_url }}): An introductory one-on-one session to get to know one another. If you decide to work with me, we will develop a personalized wellness roadmap. Free.
- [60 Minute Individual Counseling Sessions]({{ '/services/individual-counseling/' | absolute_url }}): Standard 60-minute individual counseling. Longer sessions are available by request. $130 per hour.
- [90 Minute Group Counseling Sessions]({{ '/services/group-counseling/' | absolute_url }}): $150 per participant per group. Topics include Celebrating Neurodiversity, Men’s Mental Health, Surviving and Thriving with ADHD and Autism, and Surviving and Thriving with Complex/Chronic Illness.
- [Intentional Peer Support Training (Individual and Organizational)]({{ '/services/intentional-peer-support-training/' | absolute_url }}): Trainings and certification in Intentional Peer Support are available by request, for individuals and for Respite Programs or other mental health organizations.

## About

- [My Personal and Professional Journey]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Lived experience with mental health challenges, evidence based traditional mental health modalities, and humanistic alternatives to the mainstream system. Specialties: Suicidology; Chronic Depression/Treatment Resistant Depression; Neurodiversity; Complex/Chronic Illness.
